items.title: Coinbase Swings to $719 Million Q3 Profit on Crypto Gains
items.summary: Coinbase reported third-quarter net income of $719 million, driven largely by gains on its crypto holdings, as revenue held flat at $1.22 billion.

items.title: Why Switzerland’s first genuine spot bitcoin ETF could soon attract overseas banks and brokers
items.summary: SIX Swiss Exchange confirms international access, while FINMA explains why it approved the fund and whether ether and solana ETFs could follow.

items.title: Morning Minute: Hedge Funds Left the BTC ETF Trade and Sovereign Wealth Stepped In
items.summary: Now the BTC ETFs have flipped green for the month after $400M+ inflows this week, setting the stage for a big November.

items.title: Bitcoin lending and yield could drive next wave of institutional demand, Rootstock says
items.summary: A new report argues that putting institutional Bitcoin holdings to work through lending, collateral and financing could create demand beyond its store-of-value role.
